verdict.rationale: Unleash implements RBAC at both root and project levels, with enterprise custom roles, plus scoped API tokens (backend tokens scoped to project+environment, frontend tokens marked non-secret), and change requests to gate approvals for changes in an environment — directly matching the governance story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the permission granularity beyond docs (only vendor docs/GitHub cited, no third-party audit or user report confirming enforcement).
